O.outcome_detail: final German M2 examination accuracy after rescuing T1 errors

result.effect: Gemini system 94.3% (298/316) and GPT-5 system 95.6% (302/316) after rescue

cells.quote: Following the application of the 2-tiered rescue protocol, the final accuracy for the Gemini system (Flash and Pro) was 94.3% (298/316; 95% CI 91.18%-96.37%). The final accuracy for the GPT-5 system (Instant and Thinking) was 95.6% (302/316; 95% CI 92.70%-97.34%).

O.outcome_detail: odds of a correct model response

result.effect: Gemini OR 0.579 per 1-point increase; GPT-5 OR 0.523 per 1-point increase; both P<.001

cells.quote: For every 1-point increase on the 5-point difficulty scale, the odds of a correct T1 response decreased by 42.1% for Gemini Flash (odds ratio [OR] 0.579, 95% CI 0.425-0.788; P<.001) and by 47.7% for GPT-5 Instant (OR 0.523, 95% CI 0.379-0.720; P<.001).
